dataset.name: DuRetrieval fixed Chinese comparison subset
dataset.license: Not declared in the pinned MTEB card; local evaluation only, corpus is not redistributed by this project
dataset.scope: Source dev subset, not an official full-corpus benchmark or blind holdout. No document-length filtering or truncation. Unjudged is not negative.
dataset.limitations: All original judgments for selected queries are retained. Corpus reduction changes difficulty; lexical distractor selection is conditioned on BM25. No independent no-answer labels. Possible embedding training exposure to this public dataset.
